ranked.headline: Pretrained sequence models and predicted structures guide biomolecular design
ranked.summary: Recent work couples pretrained sequence models with AlphaFold3 structures and preference or developability objectives for design and prediction.

ranked.headline: Generative and language models now span RNA, protein, and mutation-level prediction
ranked.summary: Multimodal and generative foundation models for RNA and proteins are now trained on aligned sequence, structure, and evolutionary data.

ranked.headline: Learned fusion and alignment of heterogeneous omics and histology modalities
ranked.summary: Methods now model per-modality uncertainty and align modalities without paired data across bulk, single-cell, spatial and histology inputs.

ranked.headline: Graph and attention models infer regulatory structure from single-cell transcriptomes
ranked.summary: A generalization benchmark now tests whether pretrained single-cell foundation models encode transferable regulatory knowledge.

ranked.headline: Neural biomarkers fail to generalize beyond the cohorts where they were developed
ranked.summary: Cross-population evaluation is becoming a primary design element as EEG and TMS biomarkers face transfer failures across cohorts.

ranked.headline: Computational tools now target noisy steps in single-cell and spatial transcriptomics…
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers address specific analytical artifacts such as RNA degradation, probe off-target binding, and multiplets in single-cell data.

ranked.headline: Long-read and Hi-C scaffolding yield chromosome-scale genomes across diverse eukaryotes
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications pair HiFi or long reads with Hi-C or Omni-C to produce chromosome-scale references across diverse taxa.

ranked.headline: Distribution shift tests expose limits of scaling in molecular ML
ranked.summary: Benchmarks under random and scaffold splits and homology-controlled partitions now test whether molecular models generalize beyond training distributions.

ranked.headline: Genetic and dynamical models resolve heritable, age-linked brain morphometry variation
ranked.summary: Repeated-scan, template-free, and epoch-resolved approaches now address measurement error and representation structure in brain MRI-derived phenotypes.

ranked.headline: Learned representations and gut phage reconstructions expand microbial genomic inference
ranked.summary: Annotation-light models and large metagenome-derived catalogs are now applied to bacterial and viral genomes for surveillance and discovery.

ranked.headline: In-silico models link noise, network structure, and spatial rules to emergent dynamics
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published study model how noise, attractor pruning, spatial grammars, and connection weights shape emergent biological behavior.

ranked.headline: Label-efficient deep learning for biomedical microscopy and histopathology images
ranked.summary: Annotation scarcity limits biomedical imaging, and recent preprints use molecular measurements and direct regression to bypass manual masks.

ranked.headline: Benchmarks and simulations test population genomic inference under selection and…
ranked.summary: Ancient and historical genome datasets now allow explicit benchmarking of selection and imputation tools against simulated and empirical data.

ranked.headline: Learned representations guide ligand design, lead optimization, and protein-ligand docking
ranked.summary: Recent published work couples learned molecular representations with optimization, scoring, and docking for ligand and lead design.

ranked.headline: Germline Variants Mapped to Regulatory Networks and Disease Risk Across Cells
ranked.summary: Variant interpretation is shifting from bulk association toward cell-state, tissue-specific, and personal-genome resolution.

ranked.headline: Open-source workflows turn raw sequence reads into taxonomic and phylogenetic outputs
ranked.summary: Recent tools drop reliance on reference databases, assembly, or negative controls while adding explicit validation and benchmarking.

ranked.headline: Dynamical models link phenotype, adhesion and drugs to spatial tumour organization
ranked.summary: Five April–May 2026 preprints apply explicit dynamical models to how plasticity, adhesion and drug effects shape spatial organization in growing and invading…

ranked.headline: Shiny and graphical frameworks make multi-omics analysis accessible across data types
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and one publication package spatial, single-cell, mutational-scanning and GWAS workflows into interactive or cross-language tools.

ranked.headline: Genomic dosage and sequencing context shape readout accuracy and benchmarking
ranked.summary: Copy number and replication timing bias ATAC-seq peaks, prompting WGS-based control and cross-platform methylation benchmarks.

ranked.headline: Physically and dynamically constrained models are recasting noninvasive brain mapping
ranked.summary: Recent preprints impose neural dynamics and cortical geometry as explicit constraints on noninvasive brain recordings.

ranked.headline: Representation engineering and ML models for high-dimensional microbiome and immune data
ranked.summary: Recent studies apply tree ensembles, similarity-aware kmers, and feature selection to microbiome, immune, and proteogenomic datasets.

ranked.headline: Longitudinal clocks decompose biological age per individual, module, and organ
ranked.summary: Per-individual and organ-resolved aging clocks are moving beyond single snapshots toward trajectory-based measures of biological age.

ranked.headline: Protein Language Model Embeddings Applied to Peptide and Allergen Prediction
ranked.summary: Pretrained protein embeddings and deep classifiers are now applied to peptide aggregation, antimicrobial activity, and allergenicity prediction.

ranked.headline: Tools add spatial structure, richer models, and missingness to evolutionary analysis
ranked.summary: Recent open-source releases extend structure-informed analysis, richer evolutionary models, and missing-data simulation in accessible packages.

ranked.headline: Graph and transformer models infer disease-linked genes and RNAs from expression data
ranked.summary: Transformer and graph networks increasingly prioritize candidate disease genes, lncRNAs, and miRNAs from expression and multi-omics data.

ranked.headline: Microbial genome tools standardize taxonomy, function, and community design predictions
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications package microbial genome and metagenome analyses into standardized, benchmarked, or web-accessible platforms.

ranked.headline: Heterogeneity-aware models for parameter inference from sequence and count data
ranked.summary: Recent work derives bias for compositional abundance estimates and finds mixture models fit heterogeneous phylogenomic data best.

ranked.headline: MD simulations dissect membrane protein transport, channel block, and lipid effects
ranked.summary: Coarse-grain and all-atom MD now resolve membrane protein mechanisms at molecular detail, spanning transport, channel block, and lipid-driven complex assembly.

ranked.headline: Matched-reference benchmarking of Xenium, Visium HD, MERSCOPE and CosMx spatial platforms
ranked.summary: Recent matched-reference datasets and cross-platform atlases now allow quantitative comparison of spatial transcriptomics platforms on shared tissue.

ranked.headline: Physics-based models drive pharmacophore screening and coarse-grained complex modelling
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers add MARTINI-based coarse-graining to HADDOCK3 and MD-derived pharmacophores for PPI stabilizer screening.

ranked.headline: Transcriptional models resolve spatial niches and BMP/TGFβ signaling from single cells
ranked.summary: Single-cell and spatial transcriptomic datasets now support quantitative inference of cell-cell communication and signaling states from transcripts alone.

ranked.headline: Generative models redesign proteins and peptides within reduced amino acid alphabets
ranked.summary: A Science study yields a viable E. coli with a 19-amino acid alphabet, extending structure-constrained design to whole cells.

ranked.headline: Chromatin architecture across scales shapes regulatory element activity
ranked.summary: Methods now resolve 3D compartments, nucleosome distortion, and repeat-resolved chromatin at single-molecule, single-cell, and spatial scales.

ranked.headline: Deep learning models extend gene prediction, protein function, and metagenome binning
ranked.summary: Learned models now annotate eukaryotic genomes, protein function, and metagenomic bins using lineage-aware, structural, or taxonomic priors.

ranked.headline: GWAS Results Are Being Integrated Into Genomic Prediction and Strain Prioritization
ranked.summary: GAPIT v4 reports over 20% accuracy gain from BLINK-based GWAS input over GBLUP alone on a real trait.

ranked.headline: Membrane context and self-association reshape conformational ensembles in four systems
ranked.summary: Combined structure prediction, enhanced sampling, and all-atom MD quantify membrane-dependent conformational states across four distinct systems.

ranked.headline: Multimodal models pair genetic and clinical inputs to predict disease risk
ranked.summary: Genetic association, clinical and ECG data are now being fused with learned models to predict migraine, cardiovascular and type 1 diabetes risk.

ranked.headline: Mobile and repetitive genomic elements diversify across bacteria, yeast, and viruses
ranked.summary: Genome-scale surveys of 40,000+ bacterial and 118,019 genomes now resolve repeat and replicon architecture beyond single lineages.

ranked.headline: Mechanistic models link backward bifurcation, dispersal, and trade-offs to persistence
ranked.summary: Recent work applies mechanistic models to plant disease, species exclusion, and microbial nutrient strategies under fluctuating supply.

ranked.headline: Refining DIA proteomics quantification and assessment of cancer protein resources
ranked.summary: Recent work targets missing-value recovery and accessible post-search assessment in DIA quantification, alongside harmonized cancer proteomics resources.
